race.comment: CASTLEBAR ROAD (2) has good early toe and is drawn to advantage. Is ticking along nicely this prep and finds a suitable race to add another win to the tally. Expect him to bounce straight to the front and prove tough to run down. RED BERYL (3) failed to live up to market expectation last start but had been going much better prior. Has been freshened with 55 days in between and gets in well with the 2kg claim. Expecting a sharp bounce back. MYSTERY LAD (1) has gone better than his form reads since resuming from a short spell and should be nearing a peak effort. Lugs the big weight but is aided by the 4kg claimer sticking. Can play a major role. SHAGGY ROGERS (12) has failed to threaten of late but will find this a fair bit easier. Not completely dismissing him from filling a minor spot.
